create_results_accumulator: create a ResultsAccumulator instance to collect predictions and targets across distributed processes
update_accumulator_with_tensors: update a ResultsAccumulator with prediction, target, and index tensors from a batch
accumulate_gathered_results: call accumulate on a ResultsAccumulator to gather and order all predictions and targets
use_noop_accumulator: use a NoOpAccumulator as a no-op placeholder that discards all update calls
cat_and_gather_tensor_list: concatenate a list of tensors and gather them across all distributed processes
